acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves the bounded QuoteFlow Proofloom-AgentFlow trust pilot at exact revisions; production, customer, and business outcomes require separate evidence.
acceptance.decisionAuthority: repository owners for QuoteFlow, Proofloom, and AgentFlow
evidenceRequired: The exact QuoteFlow authority set, Proofloom governance result, handoff v2, AgentFlow enforcement, receipt, rendered evidence, and recovery cases are retained with digests.
All dependency tasks have evidence-backed terminal dispositions and the final report records accept, defer, or reject without collapsing claim boundaries.

completionCriteria: The pilot begins from a tracked and owner-ratified QuoteFlow product-intelligence authority set, including its canonical journey, metrics, experiments, guardrails, and event schema.
Proofloom reports READY only for the exact converged authority snapshot and locks on every tested addition, change, removal, untracked authority, missing journey, and unrelated E2E substitution.
AgentFlow independently enforces the exact handoff v2 snapshot before immutable-plan binding or execution and returns a digest-bound receipt.
Fresh negative-path evidence covers dirty worktree, commit drift, source drift, authority drift, missing proof, wrong dependency state, and absent human acceptance.
All governed backlog items have explicit dependencies, acceptance evidence, validation, authority boundaries, and a valid terminal disposition before completion is claimed.
The three repository owners record accept, defer, or reject decisions at exact revisions.
nonObjectives: Do not infer customer acceptance or business outcomes from local or CI evidence.
Do not execute cross-repository writes without separately authorized scope in each repository.
Do not close the pilot while any dependency lacks an evidence-backed terminal disposition.
objective: Qualify the QuoteFlow pilot as the first end-to-end proof that Proofloom and AgentFlow fail closed on stale or incomplete authority.
title: Accept the cross-system trust pilot
